entries.topic: The one-way mirror: Israeli operations against the US, US visibility limits, reporting

claims.text: Pollard arrested 21 Nov 1985 leaving Israeli embassy property; pleaded guilty 4 Jun 1986; life sentence 4 Mar 1987; Israel apologized 1987 but called it a rogue operation until 1998 when Netanyahu acknowledged him as agent; released 20 Nov 2015; parole expired 20 Nov 2020; arrived in Israel 30 Dec 2020, greeted by Netanyahu

CIA 1987 damage assessment: about 800 documents and ~1,500 messages; taskings on Arab states, Pakistan, USSR; Israelis 'never expressed interest in US military activities, plans, capabilities, or equipment'
NUMEC: 'strong but not incontrovertible evidence that a diversion did occur'; AEC found no evidence of theft; CIA operational documents not released; no charges

NSA 2008 document: Israel 'also targets us'; NIE ranked Israel third most aggressive service against the US; Netanyahu's office: 'The state of Israel does not conduct espionage against the United States'
WSJ Mar 2015: Israel spied on US–Iran talks and passed material to members of Congress; WSJ 29 Dec 2015: NSA kept intercepting Netanyahu's communications after Jan 2014 curbs

Politico 12 Sep 2019: IMSI catchers near the White House linked by FBI/DHS analysis to Israeli agents; no public rebuke; Israel called it a 'blatant lie'. June 2026 DIA reportedly raised counterintelligence threat for Israel to 'critical' (Wikipedia summary)
2007 NSA history: exchange 'arguably tilted heavily in favor of Israeli security concerns'
NSM-20 report 10 May 2024: Israel had not shared complete information; difficult to reach conclusive findings given lack of US personnel on the ground
Pentagon Nov 2023: unarmed US drone flights over Gaza in support of hostage recovery
WSJ Apr 2024: after Oct 7 US expanded sharing incl. live drone feeds; US had previously relied largely on Israel for Gaza intelligence
Reuters Dec 2025: US briefly cut a live drone feed in 2024 and restricted some intelligence use over civilian deaths
Leahy: ILVF decisions at Deputy Secretary level, unique to Israel; Israel may take up to three months to answer; no ineligible unit identified in four years (Blaha)
Classified State OIG report (Oct 2025): 'many hundreds' of potential violations; review would take 'multiple years'
Foreign journalists barred from independent entry to Gaza since Oct 2023; Supreme Court rejected FPA petition 8 Jan 2024; still barred Oct 2026
NSO tools hacked at least nine State Department employees (2021)
Israeli officials reportedly seized NSO files; Apple cited it in dropping suit
Terms of US intelligence-sharing agreements are not public; ACLU lists data-sharing agreements with Israel among others; most recent public UKUSA text dates from 1955
Pollard damage assessment released only after an ISCAP decision in 2012; NUMEC CIA operational documents never released

Two-way flows used in the closing comparison: $38bn 2016 MOU and $3.3bn/yr FMF; Stuxnet cooperation with Unit 8200; Palantir MOD partnership; Cellebrite, Elbit America and Paragon sales to ICE/CBP; WhatsApp v NSO verdict

WSJ Mar 2015: Israel spied on US-Iran talks and shared with Congress; Netanyahu's office denied; Israeli officials said details came from French officials; US officials objected to the sharing with Congress rather than the spying.
Israel apologised over Pollard in Dec 1985 (Peres) and publicly again in March 1987.
NBC News (June 2026, unnamed officials): DIA raised counterintelligence threat from Israel to 'critical'.
